trap.label: conectivo de opinião
trap.wrong: According to me, laptops should be banned.
trap.right: In my view, laptops should be banned.
trap.why: “Segundo eu” parece natural, mas “according to” introduz a opinião de OUTRA pessoa/fonte. Para a sua, use in my view/opinion.

mcq.why: Moreover/On top of that = razão adicional.

fix.wrong: In my point of view, handwriting is better.
fix.right: In my view, handwriting is better.
fix.why: Fórmula: in my view / from my point of view.

fix.wrong: For one thing, laptops are a distraction, moreover they are heavy.
fix.right: For one thing, laptops are a distraction. Moreover, they are heavy.

fix.wrong: I am agree that notes help.

rewrite.prompt: Reescreva com In my view: “I think notes help.”
Reescreva com I would argue that: “Laptops are a distraction.”
rewrite.answer: I would argue that laptops are a distraction.

rewrite.prompt: Una com That said: “Laptops are fast. Handwriting is deeper.” (comece com Laptops are fast.)
rewrite.answer: Laptops are fast. That said, handwriting is deeper.
